prompt:
Create one richly detailed cinematic photographic still, landscape composition, of a tiny clockwork repair shop inside a rain-soaked elevated railway station in a near-future Chinese city at blue hour. The scene should feel lived-in, physically plausible and emotionally warm, not a collage or an infographic. Eye-level 35mm lens, medium-wide framing, clear foreground/middle/background depth.

There are exactly THREE adult people, arranged so all three have readable faces and distinct silhouettes. In the middle, a young East Asian woman mechanic with short black hair and a mustard-yellow work jumpsuit sits behind a walnut workbench. Her left hand gently steadies an open brass mechanical bird; her right hand holds a slim screwdriver whose tip visibly touches a screw on the bird's exposed mechanism. Show believable finger anatomy, real contact and miniature gears. At the left side, an elderly East Asian customer with silver hair and a dark indigo raincoat pours tea from a clear glass teapot into a small white porcelain cup standing on the workbench: show the teapot handle, his gripping hand, a continuous thin stream of amber tea and light steam. At the right, an adult courier with auburn hair and a burgundy jacket leans in the open doorway, carrying exactly two stacked turquoise parcel boxes with both hands visibly supporting the bottom box.

Foreground right: a small glass display dome sits near the edge of the bench and partly overlaps the courier's lower body in perspective. Exactly THREE tiny blue mechanical butterflies are displayed inside the dome, at different heights on delicate metal stems; preserve clear glass transparency and restrained reflections. Beneath the bench, one orange tabby cat sleeps curled on a folded cloth, still visible through the open gap between the mechanic's chair and a tool cabinet. On the back wall is a round analog clock whose hands show 10:10. Above the door hangs a weathered illuminated sign with these exact Chinese characters, correctly formed and easy to read: 星河修理铺. A small cream paper card on the front of the workbench bears the exact handwritten Chinese phrase: 修好再出发.

Behind the mechanic, broad rain-streaked windows reveal a single passing elevated tram and a layered city skyline fading into mist. Wet glass subtly reflects the hanging lamp and shop objects; the tram and buildings remain outside, not inside the room. One warm hanging lamp above-left illuminates faces, hands, tea steam and brass; cool cyan city light enters from the rear windows. Natural soft shadows, realistic brass patina, scratched wood, fabric weave, glass refraction and rain droplets. Balanced colors, atmospheric depth and carefully controlled highlights. Keep the important hand-object interactions, all three faces, both Chinese texts and the cat discernible within one coherent frame.
